data.name: Read User Identity Provider
data.description: This PingOne collection contains only the requests without documentation. For the official PingOne Platform API Reference documentation, see Read User Identity Provider.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the authoritative identity provider associated with a specified PingOne user. Use the response to inspect that user's identity-provider data.
Use for: read a user's identity provider, inspect authoritative identity data, retrieve user federation details
Not supported: changing the provider, creating providers, listing users

data.name: Delete user identities for a specified identity provider.
data.description:
Deletes all user identities linked to a specified identity provider.
The id request body property specifies the identity provider. To get the ID, call getUserProfiles and copy the provider_id value you want to use.
Required authentication scopes: user_write.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deletes all identities linked to a specified identity provider for a DocuSign user. Supply the provider identifier in the payload to remove those links.
Use for: remove linked user identities, unlink an identity provider, clean up user federation links
Not supported: reading identities, adding identities, managing organization providers

data.name: Read User Identity Provider
data.description:
To get data on the authoritative identity provider associated with a single user resource, the GET {{apiPath}}/environments/{{envID}}/users/{{userID}}/identityProvider operation returns the identity provider data only for the user resource with the ID specified in the request URL.
📌 NOTE

When the actor is self and the `identityProvider` attribute is not included in any provided read scope (for example, `p1:read:user*`), a 403 status is returned.

data.name: Update User Identity Provider
data.description:
Use the PUT {{apiPath}}/environments/{{envID}}/users/{{userID}}/identityProvider request to update the identity provider for the specified user. To set the identity provider to PingOne, call this operation with no payload (an empty request body).
Note: When the actor is self, a 403 status is returned and no change to the authoritative identity provider is persisted.
